## Highlights
### Improved
- Choose folder icons from the full searchable SF Symbols catalog - Read tinted folder titles more easily with semibold text and stronger contrast - Fade smoothly between pinned-tab outline colors as website colors become available
### Fixed
- Keep the Mac sidebar collapsed when opening the address editor with Command-L - Match the system dark background across Crest's app icon color palettes - Keep wide folder symbols fully visible in Icon only mode - Keep pinned-tab colors consistent when pages unload and use more representative website colors - Use favicon colors for pinned outlines when websites declare black, white, or neutral theme colors - Keep black, white, and gray favicon colors in pinned-tab outlines
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
